6.407 rsScopeReferenceUsesDataSetMoreThanOnce
Applies to RDL 2012/01
rsScopeReferenceUsesDataSetMoreThanOnce is a critical error that occurs when all scope references
to DataSet do not originate in the same scope. All references that use the Global.Scopes collection to
a target DataSet need to originate from the same scope.
